frozen_before: integration of any Sprint-5 data stream (Open Targets current release, brainSCOPE, AlphaGenome, rare-coding, CNV, math-53, developmental QTL). Sprint 1-4 results were known at freeze.

questions_never_merged.A_CAUSAL_COGNITION_GENE: does genetic perturbation of the gene affect cognition
questions_never_merged.B_NATURAL_HIGH_COGNITION_GENE: does natural variation in the gene/locus contribute to higher cognition
questions_never_merged.C_ADULT_MODIFIABLE_COGNITION_GENE: is there credible evidence that changing its function in an adult brain could alter cognition beneficially

members: NIHR BioResource Genes & Cognition, G&C-only files

ZABANEH_EXTREME.reason: HRS controls are inside Davies 2018 (verified Sprint 3.1)

association_lineages.NEW_DATASETS: a dataset found in Sprint 5 counts as an independent lineage only if its cohort list contains none of UK Biobank, HRS, 23andMe, or any Davies 2018 cohort; otherwise sensitivity only

locus_confidence.statistic: log10 Bayes factor of replication in each independent lineage: BF = exp(b*zs*zr - (b*zs)^2/2), zr = replication z aligned to the cognition-increasing allele, zs = Tweedie-shrunk discovery z (Sprint 4), b = lineage slope fixed from Sprint 4 (G&C 0.122) or estimated by IVW across all testable loci for a new lineage before any locus is inspected
locus_confidence.combination: sum of log10 BF over independent lineages only
locus_confidence.rank_uncertainty: 2,000 parametric draws zr* ~ N(zr, 1); report 5th-95th percentile rank

v2g_evidence_classes.CODING: a credible-set variant (SuSiE PIP >= 0.1 or Open Targets credible-set PIP >= 0.1) with missense / stop / frameshift / splice-donor / splice-acceptor / start-lost consequence in the gene
v2g_evidence_classes.RARE_CODING: exome-wide significant rare-variant burden association of the gene with a general-cognition/executive/memory phenotype (EA-only recorded as EA_PROXY, never counted), gene within the locus window (LD block or +-500 kb of a credible variant)
v2g_evidence_classes.QTL: strong (PP.H4 >= 0.8) gene-level colocalisation with an adult brain QTL: bulk (eQTL Catalogue adult cohorts, Open Targets brain coloc) and single-cell (brainSCOPE) collapse into ONE class when brainSCOPE donors overlap the bulk cohorts; they count as two classes only if donor overlap is documented as zero
v2g_evidence_classes.ENHANCER_LINK: a credible variant (PIP >= 0.1) inside a chromatin-based enhancer-gene link (ENCODE-rE2G / ABC / Open Targets interval E2G) to the gene in a brain or neural biosample
v2g_evidence_classes.SEQUENCE_MODEL: AlphaGenome predicted expression change of the gene for a credible variant with |quantile score| >= 0.99 in >= 1 brain/neural RNA track; in-silico; at most one class
v2g_evidence_classes.DOSAGE_CNV: a single-gene or <= 3-gene CNV in which gene dosage associates with cognition in a population sample

NOT_A_CLASS.OT_L2G: aggregator: assigned to the class of its top SHAP driver (distance/density -> positional; VEP -> CODING; coloc -> QTL; interval -> ENHANCER_LINK); never an extra vote
NOT_A_CLASS.FOCUS_TGFM_CTWAS: built on the same eQTL cohorts: contradiction check only

v2g_evidence_classes.contested_rule: a gene is CONTESTED when the primary FOCUS configuration gives another gene PIP >= 0.5 and this gene < 0.2, or when another gene in the locus holds strictly more classes

gene_classes_precedence: CONTRADICTED: independent replication z aligned < -1.96 at the locus, or classes point to another gene and this gene has none
CAUSAL_GENE_HIGH: locus L1/L2 AND (RARE_CODING or CODING with PIP >= 0.5) AND >= 1 further distinct class AND not CONTESTED
CAUSAL_GENE_MODERATE: locus L1-L3 AND (>= 2 distinct classes AND no other locus gene with >= as many classes AND not CONTESTED, OR RARE_CODING alone)
LIKELY_QTL_PASSENGER: QTL class present but CONTESTED, or GTEx v10 brain median TPM < 1 with enrichment in a non-brain tissue
LOCUS_HIGH_GENE_UNRESOLVED: locus L1/L2 and no gene at MODERATE or above
CODING_CAUSAL_LOF_ONLY: RARE_CODING (LoF/damaging) but no supported common locus
DEVELOPMENTAL_CAUSAL_ONLY: flag added to any class when adult evidence is absent and expression is PRENATAL_DOMINANT (Sprint-3 BrainSpan class) or only developmental QTLs support it

direction.rule: UNCHANGED Sprint-4 rule: >= 3 strong gene-level adult-brain QTL colocs with >= 80% polarity-adjusted sign agreement, on rows AND on independent QTL-cohort units
direction.ADULT_DIRECTION_RESOLVED: rule met on rows and units AND gene CAUSAL_GENE_MODERATE or HIGH
direction.ADULT_DIRECTION_NEAR_RESOLVED: rule met on rows and units but gene below MODERATE; OR rule met on rows only; OR >= 2 independent cohort units plus >= 1 brainSCOPE cell type all agreeing
direction.cell_type_conflict: opposite significant directions in two cell types are reported as CELL_TYPE_DISCORDANT and block RESOLVED

strata.D4: single cohort or single cell type

human_perturbation.P1: exome-wide rare-coding cognition association replicated or in >= 2 studies with non-overlapping cohorts

research_priority.method: non-dominated (Pareto) sorting over four ordinal axes: locus stratum, gene stratum, direction stratum, perturbation stratum; no weighted total score
research_priority.display_order_within_layer: count of axes at their best stratum, then locus log10 BF (disclosed as display order, not a statistic)
research_priority.top20: genes/loci from successive Pareto layers until >= 20; ties at the boundary all listed

convergence_tests.T1_rare_in_common: mean Davies MAGMA gene z of rare-coding cognition genes vs 10,000 gene sets matched on gene-length decile x NSNPS decile x LOEUF decile; one-sided
convergence_tests.T2_rare_near_loci: fraction of rare-coding genes inside the 159 LD loci vs the same matched null
convergence_tests.T3_pathway: for Sprint-3 FDR-significant common-variant gene sets: count of rare-coding genes that are members vs matched null
convergence_tests.T4_timing: Fisher test of PRENATAL_DOMINANT fraction, rare-coding vs common Bonferroni genes
convergence_tests.T5_cell_type: HPA brain single-cell type enrichment class distribution, rare vs common genes (Fisher/chi-square)
convergence_tests.power_note: with < 20 rare genes these tests have low power; a null is NOT evidence of no convergence

math_tests.M1: fraction of verified math SNPs inside the 159 general-cognition LD loci vs genomic-fraction null and matched-SNP null where available
math_tests.M2: sign concordance of math-increasing allele with Davies general-cognition z (binomial, palindromic excluded)
math_tests.M3: overlap of math-mapped genes (QTL/coding/E2G mapped, never nearest gene) with cognition causal-gene candidates
math_tests.independence_note: a UK-Biobank math factor shares participants with Davies 2018: overlap is cross-domain pleiotropy, never replication

opentargets_flags.STABLE_ASSIGNMENT: same top L2G gene in Sprint-3 (26.06) and current release
opentargets_flags.POSITIONAL_ONLY: top SHAP feature is distance or gene-density
opentargets_flags.MULTI_GENE_AMBIGUITY: top L2G < 0.5 or second gene within 0.1 of top

deep_dive_promotion: gene reaches CAUSAL_GENE_MODERATE or higher, OR ADULT_DIRECTION_NEAR_RESOLVED or better, OR human perturbation P1/P2, OR a SUPPORTED_POSITIVE_DOSAGE CNV

criteria: independent cognition association (locus L1/L2 or P1)
adult brain molecular evidence (QTL class in adult brain)
acceptable pleiotropy/safety (human review only; never auto-cleared)
adult_intervention_gate.outcome: if any is missing CHEMISTRY_GATE = CLOSED; criteria 1-5 and 7 met -> label CAUSAL_TARGET_ADJUDICATION_CANDIDATE, gate still CLOSED pending human safety review

amendments.made_before: the gene classifier was first run (no gene class had been computed)
amendments.reason: implementation found candidates that fit none of the frozen classes; residual labels are added BELOW every frozen class in precedence, so no frozen class changes

residual_labels.V2G_SUPPORTED_WEAK_LOCUS: gene holds >=1 V2G class at a locus in stratum L3/L4/NT and does not meet any frozen class (locus association not independently strong)
residual_labels.RARE_CODING_EA_PROXY_ONLY: exome-wide rare-coding association with educational attainment only (never counted as cognition)
residual_labels.RARE_CODING_SUGGESTIVE_ONLY: FDR-only / single-cohort rare-coding hit below exome-wide significance for a cognition phenotype
residual_labels.POSITIVE_DOSAGE_NOMINAL_ONLY: member of a CNV whose dosage nominally associates with higher cognition, unreplicated
residual_labels.PANEL_ONLY_NO_LOCUS_DATA: entered via Panel C/D with no evidence unit at any tested locus

amendments.also: EA-proxy rare genes get perturbation stratum P5 with a flag (not P2), because EA is proxy-only

amendments.change: winner's-curse shrinkage zs: Gaussian-KDE Tweedie replaced by an empirical-Bayes normal scale mixture (ash-style, fixed grid, EM on every 50th genome-wide Davies SNP); same estimand E[mu|z]
amendments.reason: demonstrable numerical defect: the KDE gradient is unstable in the sparse tail (z=8.33 -> -1.99; z=6.23 -> 8.88; z=6.69 -> 0.26), i.e. non-monotone and sign-flipping
amendments.disclosure: the locus ranks computed with the defective estimator HAD been viewed (research_log R05) before this amendment; the change is forced by the defect, not chosen for its effect; both versions are reported
amendments.also_affects: Sprint-4 expected concordance fraction and Gate-A locus sign-test power used the same function -> dated correction block
